description: Overlay 2 of 6 in the S3 Spine sequence. Monitors regime migration velocity and trajectory across the registered Structural Frame. Detects collapse-precursor drift signatures via ΔM (magnitude), ΔD (direction), and ΔV (velocity) vectors. Time-stamps all readings for the Temporal Regime Sequencer. Requires a validated Structural Frame from Overlay 1.
role: Velocity monitor — tracks regime migration speed and direction; early-warning system for collapse-precursor drift; time-annotator for the Temporal Regime Sequencer
